common_plane_contact_datum_audit.interpretation: 26.480mm of A8 TCP-versus-50.2 discrepancy can be a CAD-point semantic difference only if the intended physical reference were the lowest gripper vertex, which has not been established. A common plane shift to force either equality conflicts with several accepted CAD non-contact poses. Neither equality is measured ground truth.

existing_fitting_code.scripts/left_arm_board_kinematics.py:266: estimate_board_and_tcp assumes full3D board_tcp_mm for every anchor and at least4points; unsuitable for new A8 without physicalZ. Historical fouranchors mix piece/contact datums, nominalZ55, and older physical registrations.
existing_fitting_code.scripts/audit_left_arm_common_calibratio: Explicitly rejects requestedXYZ and qualitative acceptance as position ground truth; C4/C5/B3 qualified only as quasi-static torque proxies.
existing_fitting_code.scripts/fit_geometry_calibration.py:1: Legacy reduced shoulder-frame affine correction fitter; not the current seven-axis shared CAD calibration workflow.

recommendation: Keep runtime geometry unchanged. UseA8q as an explicitly taught endpoint/branch reference for fresh reverse-path geometry only. For reusable Cartesian calibration collect same-opening, same-defined physical contact point at multiple board locations/orientations with measuredXY and at least one independently measuredZ/contactplane datum; fit shared model and validate heldoutphysicalpoints.
limitations: All nominal XY labels are approximate assumptions, not metrology; A7 nominalX27.5 substitutes for old requestedX17.5 and is specially uncertain.
Historical successful grasp and recent accepted empty approach are different evidence scopes; accepted height need not mean one shared physical graspZ.
No new model, board transform, TCP, physical joint limits, or hardware plan is authorized or deployed by this audit.
A8 alone cannot distinguish board translation, wrist-local contact TCP offset, kinematic error, or object/contact semantics.
full_board_rotation_extension_note: Exploratory8parameter XY-only fit included to test whether allowing common board tilt resolves heldoutA8. Its board-normal origin is fixed only as gauge and cannot infer physicalZ.
